vaultSearch.hint: Start typing to search across all notes

bookmarks.title: Bookmarks
bookmarks.hint: Use the bookmark button to add one.

conflict.banner: This is a conflict copy of {original}: the other version, saved by sync on {stamp} (UTC) when both sides had changed it.
conflict.originalMissing: The original note no longer exists. This copy is now an ordinary note.

backlinks.title: Backlinks
backlinks.empty: No backlinks found for this note.

corePlugins.intro: Built-in plugins that ship with Noteriv, turned on or off for each vault. A disabled plugin's code is not loaded.

sandbox.renderFailed: The plugin could not render this block.

wordCount.title: {characters} characters · ~{minutes} min read
wordCount.name: Word count
wordCount.description: Word count of the open note in the status bar, plus a command and ribbon button with statistics (Ctrl+Alt+W).

flashcards.name: Flashcards
flashcards.description: Spaced repetition (SM-2) over Q:/A: pairs and {{cloze}} deletions in your notes; open it from the ribbon or the command palette.
flashcards.title: Flashcard Review
flashcards.noCards: No flashcards found. Add Q:/A: pairs or {{cloze}} deletions to your notes.

comeBack.one: {count} card reviewed. Come back tomorrow for more.
comeBack.other: {count} cards reviewed. Come back tomorrow for more.

templates.name: Templates
templates.description: Insert a template at the cursor or start a new note from one. Templates are the notes in the Templates folder.
templates.emptyFolder: Create a "{folder}" folder in your vault root and add notes to use them as templates.
templates.emptyVariables: Use variables like {{date}}, {{title}}, {{time}} for dynamic content.
templates.noNote: Open a note before inserting a template.

noteComposer.name: Note composer
noteComposer.description: Merge notes into the open note, or split the open note into several notes by heading.
noteComposer.title: Note Composer
noteComposer.addHeadings: Add file names as headings (h2) between merged notes

deleteAfter.web: Move source notes to the trash after merging

noteComposer.noHeadings: No {level} headings found to split on

skipped.one: Skipped {count} section: a note with that name already exists.
skipped.other: Skipped {count} sections: a note with that name already exists.

calendar.name: Calendar and daily notes
calendar.description: Month view of daily notes and due tasks; open today's daily note with Ctrl+D or the ribbon.
calendar.nothing: No notes or tasks for this day.

vaultInsights.name: Vault insights
vaultInsights.description: Vault statistics: activity heatmap, most connected and orphan notes, top tags, growth and vault health.
vaultInsights.title: Vault Insights

undated.one: {count} note without dates is not in the charts.
undated.other: {count} notes without dates are not in the charts.

markdownLint.name: Markdown lint
markdownLint.description: Right-hand panel listing problems in the open note (broken links, headings…); click one to jump to its line. Ctrl+Shift+L.
markdownLint.title: Lint

audioRecorder.name: Audio recorder
audioRecorder.description: Record from the microphone, save it as an attachment and insert the link into the open note.
audioRecorder.title: Audio Recorder
audioRecorder.denied: Microphone access was denied. Please allow it and try again.

saveFailed.web: Failed to save the recording. The vault's storage quota may be used up.

audioRecorder.savedNoNote: Recording saved ({time}). Open a note to insert the link.

graph.name: Graph view
graph.description: Every note and the wiki-links between them; click a note to open it. Ctrl+G or the ribbon button.
graph.title: Graph View

slides.name: Slides
slides.description: Present the open note full screen, one slide per --- section, with speaker notes and an overview.
slides.title: Presentation
slides.noNote: Open a note to present it.
slides.separatorHint: Use --- on its own line to separate slides

noteHistory.name: Note history
noteHistory.description: Time scrubber over the note's saved snapshots (Ctrl+Shift+H) and its git history; restore an earlier version.
noteHistory.noNote: Open a note to see its history.
noteHistory.restoreHint: Replace current content with this version
noteHistory.gitEmpty: No git history found for this file.

gitEmptyHint.web: It needs a git sync connection that has run at least once, with this note committed.
gitEmptyHint.desktop: Make sure the vault is a git repository with committed changes.

noteHistory.scrubberEmpty: No history yet for this note

scrubberEmptyHint.web: Snapshots are taken automatically about every 10 minutes while the note changes. Keep writing and a timeline will build up here.
scrubberEmptyHint.desktop: Snapshots are captured every time you save. Keep editing and a timeline will build up here automatically.

pdfViewer.name: PDF viewer
pdfViewer.description: Read PDFs in a tab and annotate them: highlight, underline, notes; export the annotations to a note.
pdfViewer.empty: No annotations yet. Use the highlight, note or underline tool.

board.name: Board (Kanban)
board.description: Show .board.md files and notes with board: true in their frontmatter as a Kanban board (## headings are columns, - [ ] items are cards); New board command.
board.failed: Could not create a new board.

canvas.name: Canvas
canvas.description: Free-form boards of text, note, sticky, image and group nodes joined by edges; opens .canvas files. New canvas command.
canvas.failed: Could not create a new canvas.
canvas.noImages: No images in the vault yet. Upload one with the button above.

drawing.name: Drawing
drawing.description: Freehand sketches, shapes, text and eraser; opens .drawing files. New drawing command.
drawing.failed: Could not create a new drawing.

dataview.name: Dataview
dataview.description: Query your notes with ```dataview blocks (TABLE / LIST / TASK, by folder, tag or frontmatter); Insert Dataview query command.

mermaid.name: Mermaid
mermaid.description: Diagrams from ```mermaid code blocks in the editor, reading view and PDF export. The library loads on the first diagram.

bookmarks.hint: Click the bookmark icon in the note toolbar to add one.
Right-click a file or use Ctrl+B to bookmark.
